description: REDCOM Encryption 140-2 is a FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic engine for Java and Android based environments. The engine delivers core cryptographic functions including Suite B algorithms. Also, it offloads functions for secure key management, data integrity, data at rest encryption, and secure communications to a trusted implementation.

capabilities: Hash Algorithm: SHA-1, SHA2-224, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512
